item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=''.join(l.strip() for l in Path('inputs/orf.annot.q1.fa').read_text().splitlines() if not l.startswith('>'))
print(len(s))
# 1-based start/end from getorf: [283-1335]
for st,end in [(186,341),(283,1335),(945,1043),(1064,1114),(1361,1399)]:
    sub=s[st-1:end]
    print(st,end,len(sub),sub[:30], sub[-30:])
    print('first codon', sub[:3], 'last codon', sub[-3:])
    print('translation prefix', s[st-1:st-1+30])
# find ATG and stop patterns around longest
print('around start', s[270:310])
print('around end', s[1310:1350])
PY"
